name: Forethought
summary: Customer-support AI agents (Solve, Triage, Assist, Discover, QA) trained on a company's own ticket history; Zendesk completed its acquisition on 2026-03-26. Triage tags, prioritizes and routes tickets. Claims 'Up to 98% Ticket prediction rate', undefined. No MCP server; APIs 401 keyless.

payments.notes: Read 2026-11-12: three tiers, Team, Professional and Enterprise, each 'Get a Quote'. Team lists ready-to-use triage models; custom handoff models are counted per tier (3, 6). Solve API and Analytics API are Enterprise rows. A Proof of Value replaces a free trial. Nothing prices a call.

agentAccess.notes: No MCP server found. Keyless 2026-11-12: POST api.forethought.ai/api/predict (Triage) 401 'Not authenticated'; GET app.forethought.ai/solve/api/v1/metadata 401 'Invalid token'; both carry x-zendesk-zorg. Docs at support.forethought.ai redirect to a sign-in page.

jobs.summary: Triage tags tickets by intent, sentiment, urgency and language with models trained on the customer's history; the tags drive routing in the helpdesk. 'Up to 98% Ticket prediction rate' is undefined. Accuracy against human labels, time to correct assignment and re-route rate: unpublished.
